desc:
💥 Every person is a real physics body. Punch them, throw them, blast them across the map and watch what happens.

They stumble, wince and fall the way they were hit. Big hits flash an x-ray, a doctor runs in with bandages, and a grave rises for the ones who didn't make it.

⚡ 36 SUPERPOWERS
Laser eyes, telekinesis, thunder clap, web swing, time stop, tornado, giant mode, meteor strike and a nuke

🦹 6 VILLAINS
Brute smashes, Pyro sets people on fire, Speedster runs them down. Stop them, or don't

🎬 9 SCENARIOS
Prison break, bank heist, hostage rescue, outbreak, lab escape and a full frontline

🌍 15 WORLD EVENTS
T-Rex rampage, shark rain, tsunami, airstrike, bee swarm, giant dummy and a disco party

🗺️ 7 MAPS
City, construction site, playground, forest, stadium and a clean white room

👥 PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Fly together, slow time down and wreck the city as a team

🎮 Play on PC, phone, console and VR. ⭐ Like and favorite for updates!
